LearningProgress.title: LearningProgress
LearningProgress.description: Tracks user completion and scores across Financial Education modules, Courses, Cybersecurity checklists, and Quiz Challenges.

itemKey.description: Unique identifier key of the course, quiz, or module.

title.description: Display title of the completed item.

completed.description: Whether the item has been completed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CertificateRecord.title: CertificateRecord
CertificateRecord.description: Official Money Harvest certificate earned by the user upon completing courses or quizzes.

recipientName.description: Full name displayed on the certificate.

courseTitle.description: Title of the certified course or quiz challenge.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when issued via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ScamScanRecord.title: ScamScanRecord
ScamScanRecord.description: Saved AI Scam Detector analysis record for suspicious messages, links, or financial offers.

inputTitle.description: Snippet or title of the scanned message or URL.

verdictSummary.description: Summary of the AI scam detection analysis.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when scanned via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CommunityPost.title: CommunityPost
CommunityPost.description: User-authored community post sharing financial tips, scam warnings, or questions.

body.description: Content body of the community post.

likesCount.description: Number of likes on the post.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/progress/{progressId}.description: Per-user learning, quiz, course, and cybersecurity progress items.

/users/{userId}/certificates/{certId}.description: Per-user earned official Money Harvest certificates.

/users/{userId}/scam_scans/{scanId}.description: Per-user history of AI Scam Detector analyses.

/users/{userId}/community_posts/{postId}.description: Per-user authored community posts and scam alerts.
